summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard is containing an oil spill off Mariveles, Bataan, removing 800 kg of oil-contaminated debris while the DENR orders assessment and containment. China has deployed more than 100 warships and coast guard vessels across the western Pacific and sent a survey vessel with unidentified equipment into Scarborough Shoal, heightening maritime tension. The U.S. Maritime Security Initiative is providing lasting capability assistance to Southeast Asian partners, including the Philippines. The Philippines is preparing security for the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila from 16 to 18 November, and the PCG delivered 7,000 DSWD food packs to disaster-affected residents in Batanes.
summary.nb: Filippinenes kystvakt inneholder et oljelekkasje utenfor Mariveles, Bataan, og fjerner 800 kg oljeforurenset avfall mens DENR beordrer vurdering og innkapsling. Kina har distribuert mer enn 100 krigsskip og kystvaktskip i det vestlige Stillehavet og sendt et kartleggingsfartøy med uidentifisert utstyr inn i Scarborough-revet, noe som øker spenningen til sjøs. USAs Maritime Security Initiative gir varig kapasitetsstøtte til sørøstasiatiske partnere, inkludert Filippinene. Filippinene forbereder sikkerhet for den 49. ASEAN-toppmøtet i Manila fra 16. til 18. november, og PCG leverte 7 000 DSWD-matpakker til innbyggere i Batanes som er rammet av katastrofen.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
